agent_summary:
Information-gathering lane for juice.lab.test (OWASP Juice Shop v20.2.0). Only http answers (https/443 refused). All 10 WSTG-INFO items were tested read-only and marked done:

- INFO-01/03 (metafiles/recon): robots.txt discloses Disallow:/ftp; sitemap.xml returns the SPA index (no real sitemap); security.txt leaks a contact email, keybase PGP fingerprint (bkimminich) and a CSAF URL referencing localhost:3000.
- INFO-02 (web server): nginx/1.30.5 via Server header; SAMEORIGIN frame options, nosniff, feature-policy and custom x-recruiting header present.
- INFO-04 (app enumeration): /ftp exposes a full directory listing of 11 sensitive files (package.json.bak, package-lock.json.bak, coupons_2013.md.bak, incident-support.kdbx, announcement_encrypted.md, encrypt.pyc, suspicious_errors.yml, etc.); main.js reveals SPA sub-apps (admin, score-board, web3-sandbox, chatbot, photo-wall).
- INFO-05 (content leakage): root HTML author comment; main.js flags Google OAuth client id + masked secrets; /rest/admin/application-configuration (unauthenticated) leaks full googleOauth clientId, privacy email, internal baseUrl localhost:3000, chatbot LLM model.
- INFO-06/07 (entry points / execution paths): enumerated /rest/* and /api/* endpoints with read params (current=, email=, to=) and client hash-routes/flows from main.js.
- INFO-08/09 (framework/app fingerprint): Angular Material SPA on a Node/Express backend (socket.io/engine.io, /rest+/api), behind nginx; app confirmed as OWASP Juice Shop v20.2.0 via /rest/admin/application-version and config.
- INFO-10 (architecture): nginx reverse proxy fronting Express app on internal :3000, local backups, LLM chatbot, Google OAuth, web3/wallet modules, realtime sockets.

Two leads recorded for other lanes: (1) medium — /ftp directory listing exposing backup/credential files (.bak, .kdbx) worth retrieval attempts; (2) low — unauthenticated /rest/admin/application-configuration and application-version endpoints. No writes were made (lane is read-only). Nothing left open.

leads.title: [agent] Directory listing of /ftp exposes sensitive backup/credential files

detail.text: GET http://juice.lab.test/ftp returns an HTML directory listing of 11 entries, including backup and secrets files: package.json.bak, package-lock.json.bak, coupons_2013.md.bak, incident-support.kdbx (KeePass DB), announcement_encrypted.md, encrypt.pyc, suspicious_errors.yml, acquisitions.md, eastere.gg, and a quarantine folder. Directory listing is enabled and discloses the presence of these files; the .bak/.kdbx files warrant a follow-up lane to attempt retrieval.
